Bold hand-inked outlines, rich cel shading, dynamic comic-book perspective, exaggerated scale and explosive acceleration. Reference image defines the exact character identity, face, costume, colors and props, NOT the background or initial camera crop. Preserve the illustrated character; no live-action or 3D makeover. YN ATV Lord — Hop On.
IDENTITY: exact young adult brown-skinned ATV rider from the reference, long black locs, amber goggles on dark riding headwear, small cheek bandage, white tank top, black cross-body harness, baggy black graphic trousers, black riding gloves, layered gold jewelry and white/black/gold sneakers. Preserve the rugged FOUR-WHEEL white/black/gold quad with chunky tires, gold suspension springs and white headlights. Keep the rider's face visible beneath the lifted goggles.
0–1.2s: establish the complete rider AND quad in his relaxed perched pose. He spots a small orange padded passenger mannequin tumbling through cyan, swings both legs into proper riding position and revs hard. The front wheels lift into a huge wheelie as his left hand reaches toward the falling mannequin.
1.2–3.2s: whip sideways with the speeding quad. He scoops the mannequin securely onto the rear seat in one clean motion; a black rear-seat safety strap visibly clicks around it. Camera pulls WAY back as the quad launches fifty feet through empty cyan toward an isolated huge red stunt ramp, a finite curved object with no road or scenery. The tires touch the ramp's lip for one forceful spring-loaded takeoff, all four suspension units compressing then extending.
3.2–4.8s: rider, quad and secured passenger perform ONE enormous aerial barrel roll. Two heavy black training spheres converge toward the passenger; the rider twists the quad so its armored front skid plate meets them instead, knocking both away in a spectacular simultaneous bounded ivory/amber impact star. The machine completes the roll upright, wheels and passenger attached in correct positions. One clear rescue-to-protection stunt, no collision with the passenger, no duplicate vehicle.
4.8–6s: snap toward his confident face as the quad drops into a controlled nose-up hover, suspension settling visibly. Exact title HOP ON slams below his shoulders with a huge engine-and-metal impact. Keep the rider, mannequin and all four wheels recognizable on cyan.
6–8s: pull back for a complete quad-and-rider hero pose. He gives a casual two-finger salute, then notices the mannequin leaning sideways and nudges it upright with his elbow without looking back. One little puff of warm gray exhaust curls from the rear and dissipates on cyan. SFX: engine rev, tire growl, seat-strap CLICK, huge takeoff burst, rotating flyby, dominant double skid-plate CRASH, title slam, suspension clunks and fading motor idle. No music, dialogue, road, landscape or full-frame smoke.

YN Gokarter — Lap Record.
IDENTITY: exact young adult brown-skinned racer with tied dark locs, small cheek bandage, red cap with goggles, black/red/white racing jacket with checker panels and flame designs, white shirt, baggy matching trousers, red/black gloves, gold jewelry and white/red/black sneakers. Preserve the low red flame-painted FOUR-WHEEL go-kart, exposed metal frame, black seat, slick tires and compact rear engine. Keep the face clear; the spare helmet from the reference is clipped securely behind the seat.
0–0.7s: complete driver drops into the kart, grabs the steering wheel and stomps the throttle. Its rear tires distort from torque for one strong anticipation beat, and two short bounded ivory/red exhaust streaks snap backward. Ahead are THREE isolated round metal checkpoint discs with one orange cone on each, suspended at different depths on pure cyan. No road connecting them.
0.7–2.5s: camera chases the kart through a breathtaking three-checkpoint figure-eight. It skims the first small disc in a tight sideways drift, launches to the second and snaps the opposite way, then vaults toward the third. Show one continuous kart, no duplicates or split-screen. Each tire contact gives a sharp red/ivory crescent that ends freely on cyan. On the THIRD checkpoint he twists into a violent 360-degree donut, the compact disc spinning underneath like a giant turntable while his kart stays controlled. The cone flies straight upward from the final tire impact.
2.5–3.5s: the final donut releases one enormous bounded ivory/red acceleration burst; the kart shoots toward camera and stops in a hard sideways hero skid, all four wheels in frame. Exact title LAP RECORD slams above the kart nose and below his face with a dominant engine-and-tire BOOM. No lap digits, scoreboard, track scenery or extra wording.
3.5–5s: pull enough to show full kart and driver. He raises a casual thumb while the cone finally drops and lands neatly on the rear engine cover. He glances at it, gives a tiny shrug, then flicks the throttle once for a final mischievous engine blip. SFX: throttle click, torque growl, three rapid tire squeals, rising jump rushes, huge final drift CRACK, title slam, cone tap and motor blip. No music, speech, crowd or opaque tire-smoke panels.

0.7–2.5s: camera whips with an explosive athletic delivery combo. He palm-launches the first parcel far left, heel-kicks the second far right, then vaults onto the largest and rides it straight ahead like a rocket while still holding the SAME phone in his left hand. The first two parcels slam into the left and right lockers; he backflips off the biggest parcel and drives it into the central locker with one enormous downward sneaker stomp. Three long BLANK receipt strips whip back toward his pouch and fold into one tiny paper stack as he catches himself in a stylish complete airborne stance. Camera snaps to his grinning face; exact title SIDE HUSTLE slams below his shoulders with the final delivery BOOM. No app interface, prices, numbers, brands or additional lettering.
3.5–5s: complete hero pose on cyan. He checks the phone once, satisfied. It immediately vibrates again and one more little parcel pokes from his pouch. He gives the camera a knowing half-smile, tugs the yellow vest straight and leans forward ready for the next run. SFX: phone buzz/tap, three package pops, fast palm and kick whooshes, roaring box flight, three escalating delivery impacts, receipt flutter, title slam and final short phone buzz.
